text.en: Sixty years on the road and the Rest is the only camp that smells the same. Fire, oats, harness grease. Sit if you've got the knees — the road's not going anywhere, whatever the toll says.
text.id: Enam puluh tahun di jalan dan hanya kamp ini yang baunya sama. Api, gandum, gemuk pelana. Duduklah kalau lututmu kuat — jalan tak akan ke mana-mana, apa pun kata tol.
